description: The sweep limits this person's plan actually enforces: the most backtests one sweep may run, the most history it may read, and how many sweeps may be in flight at once. Read these rather than guessing, and say the size in plan terms when a search is over one. Zero means no limit is enforced for this caller and -1 means unlimited; neither is a number to report as a cap.
name: get_sweep_limits
